text:
Predicates:
Create(x, y) ::: x created the game y.
Japanese(x) ::: x is Japanese.
Top10(x) ::: x is in the Top 10 list.
Sell(x, y) ::: x sells more than one million copies of game y.
Premises:
Create(japaneseGameCompany, theLegendOfZelda) ::: A Japanese game company created the game the Legend of Zelda.
∀x (Top10(x) → Japanese(create(x, y))) ::: All games in the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (Sell(x, y) → Top10(y)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be selected into the Top 10 list.
Sell(theLegendOfZelda, moreThanOneMillion) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
Japanese(create(fifa22, videoGame)) ::: FIFA 22 is made by a Japanese video game company.
